breaking_news.headline: U.S. prepares tougher Iran sanctions as Tehran rejects pressure
breaking_news.summary: Iran rejected threatened U.S. sanctions while Washington prepared a new sanctions package. Hormuz disruption continues to preserve a large oil-supply risk premium.
breaking_news.market_impact: Keeps crude, inflation expectations and long-end yields as key equity valuation risks.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Higher energy and funding costs are negative for transport and high-multiple technology; energy/materials rotation can stay supported.

breaking_news.headline: Gulf markets rise as oil gains on Iran sanction threat
breaking_news.summary: Gulf equities advanced as crude supply concerns lifted energy, materials and financial shares; Brent Friday close was $94.39.
breaking_news.market_impact: Confirms energy remains a live macro and sector-rotation driver entering the week.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Watch plastics/energy/shipping relative strength versus rate-sensitive electronics.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Alibaba launches $10.2 billion Hong Kong share placement to fund full-stack AI
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Alibaba plans to use 100% of net proceeds for AI chips, compute infrastructure and model development; the deal was upsized after strong demand.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Extends evidence that AI compute capex remains structurally strong despite financing-cost concerns.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Constructive for foundry, advanced packaging, servers, networking, PCB, power and cooling demand; monitor China-localization competition in chips.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: NVIDIA customers reportedly told AI-server prices may rise more than 15%
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Reuters cited Bloomberg reporting that memory-cost inflation could lift prices of AI servers using Vera Rubin and Grace Blackwell systems shipped in early 2027.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Supports revenue-dollar growth but raises customer ROI and financing sensitivity.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Positive mix for TSMC, memory, ODM, PCB, power and cooling; possible order-timing risk if total system cost rises too quickly.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: NVIDIA Aug. 26 earnings is this week's largest single AI catalyst
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Results will test whether AI infrastructure demand can absorb higher memory and financing costs after a volatile semiconductor week.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Potentially high beta for semiconductors and hyperscaler capex proxies.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Highest sensitivity: TSMC, CoWoS, AI server ODMs, networking, PCB, cooling and power.

taiwan_market_impact: Friday U.S. rebound supports Monday index sentiment, but SOX closed -0.51% and the chip index lost roughly 5% for the week, so do not treat the rebound as broad semiconductor confirmation.
TSM ADR +0.71% is supportive for TSMC, while NVDA -0.98% and AMD +0.81% show continued dispersion inside AI semiconductors.
Alibaba's $10.2B AI financing reinforces structural compute demand; focus on foundry, CoWoS, servers, networking, PCB, cooling and power rather than indiscriminate tech exposure.
Iran/Hormuz risk keeps Brent near $94 and can support energy/materials while pressuring transport and long-duration growth valuations.
